name: Golden Hour
source:
“Welcome to Haraya City.”

When your mother’s new job takes her to an island city, you wind up transferring to a new school in the middle of the term—and just before the deadline of a photography competition you’re determined to win!

In your search for a subject worthy of your entry, you get caught up in the lives of four remarkable young men:
• Nagi, the second son of the city’s wealthiest family.
• Kouya, a mysterious delinquent bent on justice...or revenge?
• Rui, a football star living a double life.
• Sol, a musician with a repertoire of secrets.

But with your deadline looming close, the frame of your lens can only capture one. Who will it be? And will your deepening relationship help you fulfill your dreams as well?
translation:
“欢迎来到哈拉亚市。”

母亲的新工作把她带到一座岛屿城市，你也因此在学期中途转入新学校——而且就在你决心赢得的摄影比赛截止日期前！

你寻找值得参赛的拍摄对象时，卷入了四名非凡年轻人的生活：
•凪，城里最富有家族的次子。
•晃夜，神秘的正义不良少年……还是一心复仇？
•琉伊，过着双重生活的足球明星。
•索尔，拥有一箩筐秘密的音乐家。

但截止日期越来越近，你的镜头只能捕捉其中一人。他会是谁？你们日益加深的关系，能帮助你实现梦想吗？
